actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Completely redraw the attached concept board of Bunny's fantasy OBSIDIAN GREATSWORD with ONE PRIMARY CHANGE: make the actual stone blade noticeably THICKER in its edge-on dimension. Keep the same FRONT / SIDE / FRACTURE three-part white-background board, the same object, same scale, upright orientation and full visible tip-to-pommel framing.

The attached board is the sole visual authority. PRESERVE its FRONT silhouette, total length, irregular broken tip, existing edge chips, blade width, blade-to-hilt proportions, short dark-metal guard, long black wrapped two-hand grip, small red wrap and pommel. Preserve its attractive BLACK GLASS MATERIAL: broad structured dark surfaces, sweeping curved conchoidal shell-fracture planes, bright-black reflections and restrained hard-edged cool-gray glints. Controlled large-area form shading and gloss are desired. Do not replace this with featureless flat-black coloring.

NEW THICKNESS: maximum actual blade thickness should be about 35% of the FRONT blade's maximum width. On the attached board, the front blade is about 190px wide and the old side edge about 40px; at this same scale the new maximum side thickness should be approximately 67px. This is a visual concept proportion, not a manufacturing dimension. Keep all axial lengths unchanged. Make the thickness readable across much of the slab, with irregular broken bevels rather than a thin needle or crystal sliver.

The SIDE is the TRUE 90-DEGREE ORTHOGRAPHIC EDGE VIEW of the SAME thickened object, rotated about its long axis. It must show the increased rock-slab depth. Hide the broad front face: do not draw a three-quarter face, a squeezed copy of the front, or its full large front-face scallops and shell patterns. The edge can have its own sparse small fracture planes and controlled black-glass reflections. Align front and side tip, guard, grip endpoints and pommel baseline exactly. The same guard design should physically receive the thicker slab without changing the axial lengths of guard, grip or pommel.

The FRACTURE inset remains an enlarged local broken-edge detail from this same sword, preserving the original curved shell-fracture character while revealing the thicker stone sidewall and depth. It is a detail crop, not another weapon.

Match the source's hand-illustrated 2D game-concept style and clear contours. Keep structurally motivated highlights and dark shading. Exclude random white blotches, mosaic artifacts, grain, tiny unstructured noise, glowing cracks, particles or silver-steel blade treatment. Labels only FRONT, SIDE, FRACTURE. No numbers, dimension guides, character or scene.

reference_inputs.role: Sole whole-board visual authority: user-selected front geometry, hilt, black-glass material, conchoidal fracture structure, composition and scale. Change blade depth/side thickness only with coherent fracture closeup.

method: built-in image_gen.imagegen; complete board redraw; actual tool PNG copied byte-exact; WebP lossless only
reference_basis: User selected V2 appearance/material; earlier V2 trial rejection remains historical, not retroactively passed. No V10 flat-front reference was sent.
limitations: 单件正面、侧面与断口细节概念板；人物握持、背负与累计三视尚未绘制。
总长0.85H0为设计设定，未作人物合绘对位或制造验证。
当前厚宽比实测约0.38，未声称精确命中初拟0.35。
可见红黑缠绕段只描述图面分区，不代表实际可握功能长度。
